sources.fullCitation: Landesarchiv Berlin, P Rep. 800, Nr. 284. Namensverzeichnis Heiratsregister 1927, Standesamt Berlin I. Alphabetical entries for Bronisław Kaper and Eleonora Sirot, both referring to marriage-register no. 273, 30 June 1927; PDF pp. 15 and 28.
sources.title: Marriage-register name index, Standesamt Berlin I — Kaper and Sirot, 1927
sources.researchNote: The linked 37-page PDF is a marriage-register name index, not the full marriage act. Its cover identifies Standesamt Berlin I, P Rep. 800, Nr. 284, and 1927. The Kaper entry is on PDF p. 15 and the Sirot entry on p. 28; both show 30 June and register no. 273. The structured date describes the marriage indexed, not an independently dated compilation of the index. The archive’s official holdings list identifies P Rep. 800 as the former Berlin I district registry for Mitte. It must not be confused with the separate foreign-registry function of Standesamt I in Berlin. M060 and M061 reproduce cropped index entries, not extracts from the full marriage act.
